Cumulative 83,377.13 = 55,909.71 (last) + 27,467.42 (this), and the balance line closes the same way: the This-Report balance is printed in accounting parentheses as (15,987.11) because the period spent far more than it raised, and 19,087.00 - 15,987.11 = 3,099.89, the printed cumulative balance. The negative is real and is kept negative.

itemized.notes: James Ebert's SECOND 2026 filing in this chunk - the June 16 Primary Election report, following his May 26 pre-primary report (key c2dfd036), whose 74,996.71 / 55,909.71 cumulative figures are exactly this filing's Last Report column, so the two chain cleanly. The 2026 county form, typed, three pages: p1 cover (signed 6-15-2026, though index.csv carries a blank filing date), FORM A on p2 and FORM B on p3, both NATIVELY LANDSCAPE (axis 'y'). A layout difference WITHIN one document worth recording: Form A prints a single-line column header and no banner strip, while Form B prints a two-line header PLUS a blank banner band, so the two sheets' data rows start at different band indices - page-to-page grid habits are not constant even inside a single filing. IN-KIND items appear on BOTH schedules by design (Bell Printing 200.00 and Gibson Green Acres Dairy 3,000.00 each appear once as a contribution and once as an expenditure); both sides reconcile to the cent WITH them included, so they are not double counts to be netted out. On this filing the county redacted ONLY the street portion of each address: the candidate's own City/Zip (Farr West 84404) and every donor's city/state/zip print in full, so donor_city/donor_state are complete here. SCANNED, not a Polimorphic e-filing: no text layer over any page and no Polimorphic footer.
